page: Microsoft Azure D32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 series. It is powered by AMD EPYC 9V74 processors operating at 3.7 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 vCPUs derived from 16 dedicated physical cores with multithreading enabled (2 threads per core). Cache resources include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster. Instruction support includes modern vector and crypto primitives such as AVX-512 (f, vnni, and bf16 extensions), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The system contains no discrete GPU accelerators.

Memory capacity is configured at 128.0 GB of RAM, adhering to a standard balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Attached to the instance is a bundled local NVMe SSD volume measuring 1890 GB, designated for high-speed temporary storage and caching workloads. In terms of memory performance, uncached large-block throughput reaches 77.97 GB/sec for reads and 55.91 GB/sec for writes, earning a strong PassMark memory rating of 2757.75.

Benchmark outcomes show high single-core compute performance, recording a Geekbench single-core score of 2006.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 3080.15 (both in the top 25%). Multi-core throughput remains solid with a Geekbench multi-core result of 16251.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 46702.25. Cryptographic acceleration performs in the top quartile (38576.24 in PassMark CPU encryption). In machine learning inference without discrete GPUs, execution on smaller models (135M) achieves top-tier results (2852.74 prompt tokens/sec), while medium-sized models (7B) achieve average throughput at 90.52 prompt tokens/sec and 17.19 generation tokens/sec.

The combination of 32 dedicated vCPUs, 128 GB memory, and high-capacity bundled NVMe storage provides strong resource density for demanding enterprise tasks. It is well aligned for mid-to-large relational database servers, Redis in-memory stores (demonstrating 44.48 million SET operations per second), static web serving clusters, and automated build or CI/CD pipelines needing fast local scratch space.
description: Microsoft Azure D32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with AMD EPYC 9V74 processors running at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 128.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core), it provides a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. Local ephemeral storage includes an integrated 1890 GB NVMe SSD, while discrete GPU acceleration is absent. Hardware performance benchmarks show top-quartile results in single-core compute (2006.0 Geekbench score) and encryption processing, alongside strong small-model CPU inference capabilities. Multi-core operations, compiler execution, and database benchmarks land in the middle tier. With dense vCPU allocations, balanced RAM, and low-latency NVMe scratch space, the instance fits enterprise database systems, caching nodes, continuous integration builds, and general multi-tenant web application tiers.
